1829-2301-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1829-2301-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

549-6495-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-6495-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 3.
549-6495-6871--211.notes:
Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-789-3249-4474--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-789-3249-4474--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Gutter Grime triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-4247-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-4247-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-5490-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Pith Driller.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-5490-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1981-2415-3899-7286.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

413-1116-2738-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 6.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Tenacious Dead enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2111-3545-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1441-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1441-5777-7810.description:
Activate Bill the Pony by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1879-3259-7659.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-3259-7659.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Brimaz as attackers.
Brimaz triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

430-2743-6222-6705.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-2743-6222-6705.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", creating at least four token copies of Biovisionary due to Esix and Quina.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

3259-7296-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-5195-7417-7420.description:
Cast the copy of the spell from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Sanar, Unfinished Genius, which enters prepared.
Resolve the Molten-Core Maestro trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding the one non-red mana you need to cast the spell from step 1.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3378-3821-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
3378-3821-6991.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Donnie & April and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3378-3821-6991.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2292-7124-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2292-7124-7357.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a 1/1 Devil creature token.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Devil.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-7297.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is at least level 2 is level 3

3835-5078-5849.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} due to Fortune Teller's Talent.
Repeat.

620-3532-5078-7010.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
620-3532-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
620-3532-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Yotian Dissident.
Repeat.

141-3440-5147.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

4222-4249-6474.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 4.
4222-4249-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Freed from the Real attached using Nykthos's ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

338-3197-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3197-4716.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-4730-5686-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sparring Mummy, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sparring Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

366-406-1339.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
366-406-1339.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Purphoros, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Purphoros triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3470-4365-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3470-4365-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3470-4365-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra each trigger twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2557-5189-5231-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2557-5189-5231-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1447-2719-5231.description:
Cast Angel of Glory's Rise by paying {5}{W}{W}.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, adding {R}.
Resolve the Angel of Glory's Rise trigger, exiling all Zombies, and then returning all Humans from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Choose to have Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enter the battlefield as a copy of Angel of Glory's Rise.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

7-4489.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that has Morph or Megamorph.
You control at least three creatures with +1/+1 counters on them.
7-4489.description:
Cast the creature using its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0}, putting it face-down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face down creature face up, allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

1247-1323-2021-2060.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1247-1323-2021-2060.description:
Activate Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pili-Pala.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting a growth counter on itself.
Activate Kraj using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping Kraj, adding {1}.
Activate Kraj using its own ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
 Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting a growth counter on itself.
Activate Kraj using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from Kraj, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2026-3525-3756.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
2026-3525-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat any number of times.
